standard_prerequisites.name: Graphons and exchangeable random graphs, distributive Markov categories, affine monads, Rado graph and nominal sets, internal integration and accessible functors

difficulty_reason: The authors construct finitely supported internal probability measures over Rado-nominal sets, internal integration and probability kernels, prove self-commutation for the graphon-induced measure, and build the least commutative affine probability submonad used to interpret random-graph programs. The combined construction realizes Erdos-Renyi graphons beyond the black-and-white measure-theoretic setting. These are retained as one H2 semantic framework, not standalone corollary/support counts; original Proof notes and all support-bounded/internal-additivity hypotheses are preserved.
